name: Google Pixel 3a
notes: wlan0 ath10k_snoc comes up with EEPROM regdomain 0x0, which the ath driver maps to CTRY_UNITED_STATES, hard-disabling ch 12/13 in 2.4 GHz. Our patch maps unprogrammed EEPROMs to WOR5_ETSIC (0x65) and uses ath_world_regdom_63_65 as custom base so channels 12/13 remain enabled. Verified 2026-10-18: a WPA2 network on channel 13 (2472 MHz) connects with options cfg80211 ieee80211_regdom=DE. 5 GHz (DFS ch 116) crashes wlan firmware (halphy_caldb.c assertion) — separate issue, not fixed by the regdom patch.
